sourceSentences: Whenever a nearby enemy dies, Trundle heal [heals] himself for key=% [1.8 + (5.5-1.8)/17*(x-1) for 20] of their maximum health.
Trundle empowers his next basic attack within 7 seconds to have an uncancellable windup, gain 25 bonus range, deal bonus physical damage and slow the target by 75% for 0.1 seconds.
Chomp basic attack reset [resets] Trundle's basic attack timer.
Chomp will still incur the attack damage increase for Trundle even if the attack is dodged, blocked, missed while he is blind [blinded], or it is blocked by spell shield.
Spell shield will only block the attack damage reduction and slow.
Trundle erects a pillar of ice at the target location for 6 seconds, which airborne [knocks back] units hit up to 225 units from its center. The pillar acts as terrain and slows nearby enemies.
Pillar of Ice displaces allied units away from the area but does not render them airborne.
Allied channel [channels] (e.g. , ) will be interrupt [interrupted] however.
Pillar of Ice cannot be placed inside impassable terrain. Attempting to do so will cause the pillar to spawn in the nearest available spot of accessible terrain.
Half of the drain's total damage, healing, and resistances reduction is applied on-cast, while the other half is applied every second over the next 4 seconds.
The resistances reduction on the target will linger for 4 seconds after the drain has ended.
Trundle will lose the buff if the target loses the debuff, for example if it enters resurrection.
Trundle's passive is whenever an enemy dies nearby him, he heals himself. This includes minions so he's just constantly healing.
It then stays for 6 seconds acting as terrain and slowing nearby enemies.
For combos, your go-to is to use W into your pillar and ult. From here, attack into Q before spamming away with more attacks.
And even if the fight's an even trade, you absolutely love this as you'll just start healing up when their minions start dying.
Ideally, use your ultimate on a tank to make yourself very tanky and it's just funny watching an Ornn get deleted like an ADC.
lead with Pillar of Ice placed slightly behind and to the side of the enemy to force them to walk through the slow
the pillar physically blocks paths forcing enemies to walk around it through the slow field
Chomp's auto-reset lets Trundle proc it in under 2 seconds
use it at the start of the fight when the enemy tank has their full resistances to steal the maximum possible stats
Flash is essential on Trundle for Flash-Pillar combos that create impassable terrain directly on top of fleeing enemies
